events.event_name: CHANEL COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU Event
events.what_it_is: An official CHANEL fragrance experience for COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU in the Meatpacking District.
events.what_is_free: Admission to the fragrance experience is free. Appointments are limited, but CHANEL explicitly encourages walk-ins during event hours.
events.caveats: Appointments are limited and optional; CHANEL says walk-ins are encouraged. Normal capacity limits can still apply.
events.practical_notes: Official CHANEL hours are September 12–13 from 10 AM–7 PM, with additional dates September 18–20. Use the official event page for current appointment availability, but an appointment is not required for the advertised walk-in path.

events.what_it_is: A two-day NYFW pop-up with styling touch-ups, a photo booth, Calzedonia legwear, customization, coffee and branded giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Public admission, coffee, hairstyle touch-ups, photo booth access and branded stickers are advertised as complimentary. Embroidery is tied to purchase of the 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs.
events.caveats: The public-access details are supported by current event listings sourced to Calzedonia. Merchandise is sold on site, and embroidery requires purchase of the specified knee highs.
events.practical_notes: September 12–13, 12–5 PM daily at 188 Lafayette Street. No advance RSVP or approval requirement is stated in the verified listings.

events.address: North Esplanade by The Rink, 45 Rockefeller Plaza, New York, NY 10111
events.what_it_is: A Sally Hansen NYFW activation at Rockefeller Center centered on the Miracle Gel Bold Glam collection and runway-ready nail moments.
events.what_is_free: The activation is listed by Rockefeller Center as part of its free, public NYFW programming. Current event listings also advertise nail touch-ups.
events.caveats: Rockefeller Center confirms the dates, hours and location. Any promotional nail service remains subject to on-site capacity and availability.
events.practical_notes: Saturday, September 12 from 12–6 PM and Sunday, September 13 from 10 AM–6 PM at the North Esplanade by The Rink. No RSVP or approval requirement is published.
